# RobotExpressive / Morrow and Riot

Original model by Tomas Laulhe, modifications by Don McCurdy. CC0.
Source and license: https://threejs.org/examples/webgl_animation_skinning_morph.html
Asset: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/dev/examples/models/gltf/RobotExpressive/RobotExpressive.glb
Downloaded 2026-09-27. Included locally; no runtime third-party asset requests.

Morrow and Riot are Detention variants of the same rig, with recoloured materials, independent facial performance and a brow guard on Riot. They are not two independently modelled characters.
